content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Lemon squeezy

Sovereign commerce infrastructure is a foundational solution for digital creators in restricted countries. It allows them to sell digital products without relying on mainstream payment platforms that often exclude certain regions. This matters because the inability to process payments can cripple a creator's business, limiting their reach and revenue potential. By implementing a self-contained system, creators can bypass these limitations, ensuring they have full control over their sales and customer interactions.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The architecture of sovereign commerce infrastructure combines several free tools to create a reliable, efficient online storefront. It uses hosting platforms like GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for website delivery, while backend logic can be handled by Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script. Order data is stored securely in Supabase or Google Sheets, and file delivery is managed through Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. This structure not only minimizes costs but also ensures that creators maintain ownership and control over their data.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This infrastructure is specifically designed for digital creators in countries that face restrictions from platforms like Stripe and PayPal. It caters to entrepreneurs in Nigeria, Ghana, Pakistan, and similar regions who seek to sell digital products such as eBooks, online courses, and software. By utilizing this sovereign solution, these creators can effectively engage with their audience and monetize their content without the fear of platform dependency or arbitrary account suspensions.
Own your digital sales infrastructure for complete sovereignty.
The Components That Make It Work Together

Key components of the sovereign commerce infrastructure include website hosting, payment processing, data storage, and file delivery systems. By using GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting, creators can set up a professional storefront. NOWPayments enables seamless crypto transactions without KYC requirements, while Supabase or Google Sheets handles order management. These components are intricately linked to ensure that creators have a smooth and efficient sales process from product listing to payment confirmation.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To deploy this infrastructure, first choose your hosting platform, either GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. Next, set up backend logic using Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script. Load your products into Supabase or Google Sheets for order management. Integrate NOWPayments for crypto payment processing. Finally, test your setup end-to-end to ensure everything works as expected. This systematic approach allows you to establish a fully operational digital store in just 48 hours.
How do I sell digital products if Stripe is not available in my country?

Platform restrictions are not a customer service problem — they are an infrastructure problem. You cannot solve an infrastructure problem by calling support or finding the right contact at Stripe or PayPal. You solve it by building on infrastructure that was not designed around those restrictions in the first place. NOWPayments operates on blockchain rails — it has no correspondent banking relationships, no AML corridors to approve, and no geographic risk model that flags your country. It verifies transactions on-chain and fires a webhook. Your Cloudflare Worker or Apps Script receives the webhook and processes the order. The entire sequence is independent of any conventional financial institution.
Bypass platform restrictions and enable global access to your products.

Check out our offerings at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html to find the best solution for your needs.
Your Deployment Checklist

Stop using a friend's account in another country — this violates platform terms and puts both accounts at risk. Create a NOWPayments merchant account under your own email — no KYC required, takes under 15 minutes. Configure wallet addresses for USDT on Tron as your primary coin and Bitcoin as your secondary. Deploy your backend — Cloudflare Worker or Apps Script Web App — and confirm the endpoint URL is accessible. Set the endpoint URL as the webhook URL in your NOWPayments IPN settings with the secret key configured in both places. Build or deploy your storefront on Cloudflare Pages or GitHub Pages. Run a mainnet test transaction — send a small amount of real USDT to your configured address, confirm the webhook fires, the order logs, and the delivery email arrives. Promote your store only after the complete test passes.
